contexts.text: He passed over the houses of the sons of Israel () = that damnation fled from (those) goods. AC 7878, Explained. AC 7928. AC 7939.
Ye pass over judgment and the love of God (). To pass over the judgment of God = [to pass over] the Divine truth; and to pass over the love of God = [to pass over] the Divine good.
He either falsifies them, or passes them over...
